title: Snow and snowflakes
examples: Do all snowflakes look the same?
Can I see the shape of a snowflake?

explain.say: Snowflakes are beautiful and look like art.
Most snowflakes have six main sides.
Each snowflake is special and unique to the world.
The way the air cools makes the crystals form.
When the air gets very cold, the snow crystals grow.
In real life, you see snowflakes on a cold day.

draw.text: See snowflakes on a cold day.

faq.q: Do all snowflakes have six sides?
faq.a: Yes, most snowflakes have six main sides because of how they grow in the cold air. You might also ask: What is the basic shape of a snowflake? Or: How many sides should a snowflake have?
asks: What is the shape of a snowflake?

faq.q: Are all snowflakes exactly the same?
faq.a: No, every single snowflake is unique, like a fingerprint. You could also ask: Can two snowflakes look the same? Or: Is every snowflake different?
Snowflakes form when the air cools down to a very cold temperature. This process causes the water vapor to freeze into crystals. You might ask: What makes snow? Or: What do snowflakes need to form?
asks: What is the process of snow making?

faq.q: What is the best way to see a snowflake's sides?
faq.a: You need to look closely at the snowflake, perhaps with a magnifying glass. You can also ask: How do I count the sides? Or: What tool helps see snowflake sides?
asks: How do I check the sides?
What do I use to see snowflake details?

faq.q: Do snowflakes only form in the winter?
faq.a: Snowflakes are usually associated with cold weather, but the process of crystal formation happens when temperatures drop. You could also ask: Can snow happen in warm weather? Or: When do snowflakes appear?
asks: Does snow need to be very cold?

facts: Snowflakes are made of ice crystals.
Most snowflakes have a six-sided shape.
No two snowflakes are exactly alike.
Snowflakes form when water vapor freezes in cold air.

quiz.say: What shape do most snowflakes have?
quiz.why: The structure of the ice crystals naturally forms six sides.

wrong.0: Eight sides is too many for the typical snowflake structure.
wrong.1: A circle is curved, but snowflakes are made of straight crystal edges.
wrong.3: Four sides is the shape of a square, but snowflakes are more complex.

quiz.say: If a snowflake is unique, what does that mean?

options.show: They are made of different materials
options.say: They are made of different materials

quiz.why: It means that even if they look similar, the pattern is different.

wrong.0: They are all made of water ice, not different things.
wrong.1: While they can change, their basic structure remains unique.
wrong.3: This is wrong because the natural process creates variations.

quiz.say: What causes the formation of snowflakes?
quiz.why: The drop in temperature causes the water vapor to freeze into crystals.

wrong.0: Sunlight warms things; cooling is what causes snow.
wrong.1: Rain is liquid water, not the frozen crystal structure of snow.
wrong.3: Wind moves the snow, but it does not create the crystals.
